title: AMMSO marks the death anniversary of Marhoom Hanif Shah
summary: Members came together as one to remember him. Mirror Lilong has the video.
image_credit: File photo: Ngangou Loukon, Lilong. Photo: Truth12345678 / [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ngangou_Loukon_Lilong_Manipur.jpg), CC BY 4.0
body:
AMMSO members came together to mark the death anniversary of Marhoom Hanif Shah, Mirror Lilong reported on its Facebook page.

In Manipuri, the post read: "Marhoom Hanif Shah gi Death Anniversary gi Mangoinana AMMSO Amata Oina Punsinkhre" (AMMSO came together as one on the occasion of Marhoom Hanif Shah's death anniversary).

The video of the gathering is on Mirror Lilong's Facebook page.
